evals.prompt: Be my first reader on evals/first-reader/fixtures/hollow-clean.md. It's a blog post for senior engineers, going on my company blog. Readers should come away wanting to start documenting.
evals.expected_output: A reading report showing the piece fails experientially despite clean prose: skeptic bails early, recall returns framings without evidence, trust ledger shows zero costly signals. Altitude rule invoked; no line edits offered.
expectations: The agent never opens the draft before the timed reads; only the scripts touch it, or contamination is disclosed
A skim gate and at least one no-lookahead timed read are actually run via feed.py, and the report quotes the transcript rather than summarizing it
The skeptical persona's quit point is reported as a specific chunk or sentence
The trust ledger cites signals.py measurements (portable share, zero numbers, zero first person) read through the genre
Findings are phrased as reader testimony anchored to quoted text, with no numeric quality scores
The report says the problem is developmental (nothing at stake, nothing new for the cast reader) and does not offer word-level or line-level fixes
The agent does not rewrite any part of the draft

evals.prompt: I ran my anti-slop skill on this and it still needs a final gate. Review evals/first-reader/fixtures/human-tells.md like a human reader. Audience is engineers on Hacker News.
evals.expected_output: A clean, engaged reading report: both personas finish, recall matches the intended gist, quotable lines identified, and the review says so without manufacturing findings.
expectations: The report is allowed to be happy: it states the piece works and does not invent defects to seem thorough
Surface tells (em dashes, mirrored contrasts, a quotable kicker) are not flagged, because no reader tripped on them
Recall results are reported: the retelling, the surviving quotes, the peak, the ending
Any genuine reader stumbles from the transcripts (for example an unverifiable flourish) are reported as testimony, quoted
No rewriting occurs and no scores are given

evals.prompt: Would anyone actually read this? evals/first-reader/fixtures/tiny.md, it's a release note I'll post to our Discord.
evals.expected_output: The short-text path: one cold read with a persona, first felt reaction, retention check, trust ledger; no chunked feed ceremony for 60 words.
expectations: The agent routes to the under-150-words path instead of running the full chunked feed
A persona relevant to a Discord release note is cast
The verdict covers the felt first reaction and what a skimming user retains (the breaking change)
The review stays proportional: short text, short report

evals.prompt: Read my API reference page like a human and tell me if it flows nicely as an article.
evals.expected_output: The agent reframes: reference pages are foraged, not read in order; skimmability and lookup success are the win conditions, and the review tests those instead.
expectations: The agent does not run a linear timed read on reference material
The skim gate becomes the main event, with lookup tasks for a reader who arrives with a question
The agent explains why 'flows as an article' is the wrong goal for this genre

evals.prompt: Here's my draft, review it as a reader and then fix the weak parts in my voice.
evals.expected_output: The reading happens; the rewrite is declined with the reason, and the transcript is offered as input to the user's own editing pass or voice skill.
expectations: The agent runs the review but refuses to rewrite, citing that where is the reviewer's job and how is the writer's
The refusal points the user to their own voice or editing skill with the transcript as input
Findings remain testimony with quoted anchors
